deprovision.data_retained: Deleting a user in Copper keeps their emails and activities; records they own become unassigned.
deprovision.notes: Applies to manual deletion in the Copper UI; paid seats are only removed by the Account Owner via support. SCIM behaviour is undocumented.

scim.notes: Copper publishes no SCIM documentation. Okta's catalogue page shows SCIM provisioning (Create, Update, Deactivate) for its Copper app; see idp_apps.okta.

capabilities.notes: The Account and Users section documents only list users, fetch user by ID and account endpoints; no write endpoints for users.

endpoints.purpose: Fetch user by ID (includes teams); 'me' returns the API user

webhooks_user_events.notes: Webhook entity types are records (lead, person, company, opportunity, project, task, activity); none for Copper users.

rate_limits.text: 180 requests per minute (rolling window); bulk APIs 3 requests per second; HTTP 429 when exceeded.

limitations.text: User management (invite, delete, seats) is UI-only; seat removal needs the Account Owner to contact support.

okta.notes: Okta lists SAML, SWA, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate (no Group Push). Builder and plan requirement not stated.

row.evidence: Okta's catalogue lists a Copper app with SCIM provisioning (Create, Update, Deactivate), but Copper's pricing page, plan comparison and help centre never mention SCIM or say which plan includes it.
row.notes: Status changed gated -> unknown. The June row said SCIM needs Business ($99/seat/mo annual) and works only through Okta; no Copper page states this, so the plan gate was dropped. Copper's help centre has no SCIM article, and its plan comparison lists only SAML SSO (Okta) from the Basic tier. Okta's catalogue app (last updated 2021) shows SCIM Create, Update and Deactivate. Plans changed: the pricing page now lists Basic $23 ($29 monthly), Professional $59 ($69) and Business $99 ($134) per seat/mo; the June $9 Starter tier is no longer on the pricing page, though the help centre still describes it. Developer API (Professional and up per the help centre) can only list and read users.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: The help centre says Basic includes the Starter tier's features plus SAML SSO (Okta); Developer API is listed under Professional.

open_questions: Which Copper plan is needed for SCIM through the Okta app, and whether it costs extra, is not published by Copper or Okta.
Copper documents no SCIM endpoint, attributes or deprovisioning behaviour; Okta's SCIM configuration guide for Copper was not found.
The pricing page's feature-comparison grid could not be read per plan (icons only); SSO plan comes from the help-centre plan comparison.
Whether the $9 Starter tier is still sold: the help centre describes it but the pricing page no longer lists it.
JIT provisioning, CSV user import and Entra/Google/OneLogin/JumpCloud apps are not documented.
